notes.title: Release postponed by few days
notes.content:
Hi to all fans of Engine Evolution 2023!

I was working hard to get the game ready for release. Sadly, I didn't manage to fish 100% of the testing in time, and I didn't manage to get the trailer ready and a few marketing materials. The new target release date is 7/8/23, but I hope I will manage to release the game sooner!

Thanks for your patience, and see you on the track soon!
The developer, Petr
